svg.text: Crosshead plates 10 mm, 50 apart: hinge hole 30.5, axle hole 20.5 120 above

svg.text: -Y plate extended to a 12 mm dead-end lug, 16.5 hole 180 above the hinge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge pin 30 x 404, R-clips both ends; sheave on a 20 mm axle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie rods 30 x 10, 420 between 20.5 and 25.5 holes; two per shell

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shear link: two 6 mm plates 87 x 30, 16 mm pin through the lug at the bottom

svg.text: Calibrated link pin about 1.9 mm, 62 above the lug pin
